name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a royalty and streaming company focused on gold exploration and development in Nevada and Idaho. The company holds royalty interests and mineral properties including the Loman, Agai-Pah, and Belshazzar projects in Nevada. With a management team carrying over 30 years of Nevada mining experience, the company is in an early asset-building phase accumulating royalties and exploration properties in one of the world's premier gold mining jurisdictions.
